headline: Disaggregated quantization specializes prefill and decode for reported LLM efficiency gains
summary: A September 2026 preprint proposes separate quantization choices for prompt prefill and token-by-token decoding, arguing that the two phases have different compute and memory bottlenecks. On released Qwen3.8-27B GGUF decoders, the authors report that an NVFP4 prefiller improved 1-bit results by 32.5 points on MMLU-Pro and 35.3 on MMMU-Pro without changing the decode checkpoint. In an 8K-prompt test on the same 27B model, SSD-offloaded disaggregated prefill reportedly reduced time to first token by 1.78× versus weight-only inference. These are author-reported results under particular model, quantization and serving conditions; no independent reproduction was performed here.
